metadata.scenario: An individual calls to ask about the availability and pricing of wellness programs for corporate employees. Category: New Inquiry. Customer type: prospect.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret. How can I help you today? Hi Margaret, this is George Williams. I’m actually calling to inquire about your wellness programs for corporate employees. Hi George! It’s great to hear from you. We currently don’t have specific wellness programs tailored for corporate employees, but I can provide you with some information on our services. Oh, I see. Can you tell me what kind of services might be beneficial for a corporate setting? Certainly! We offer a range of services including health screenings, wellness workshops, and stress management programs that can be tailored for employees. That sounds interesting. What are the typical prices for these services? For health screenings, the price can range from $65 to $80 per person, depending on the tests included. Workshops usually range from $200 to $500 for a group session. Okay, and how long do these workshops usually last? They typically last about an hour to two hours, depending on the topic and the number of participants. That’s good to know. Can you also provide information on stress management techniques that you might include? Sure! We cover techniques like mindfulness, time management, and relaxation exercises. We can customize the content based on your team's needs. That sounds valuable. Do you offer any follow-up support after the workshops? Yes, we provide follow-up consultations and resources for employees to continue their wellness journey. Great! I have a few employees who might be interested in this. What would be the next steps? I can set up a meeting to discuss your team’s specific needs and how we can tailor our programs. Would you be available for a call next week? Sure, I’m available Tuesday or Thursday afternoon. Let me check... How about Tuesday at 2 PM? That works for me! Perfect! I’ll send you a calendar invite for Tuesday at 2 PM. Thank you, Margaret. I appreciate your help today. You’re welcome, George! I'm looking forward to discussing this with you. Have a great day! You too, goodbye! Goodbye!
